title: Episode 83 — Jinda Pir Claims and the Niranjania Heirs

blocks.text: The indictment grows sharper as Hindal's circle begins to make extravagant religious claims and to rewrite sacred memory around itself. False assertions about living sainthood and fabricated lineage are presented as signs that ambition has overtaken reverence.

The corruption does not stop with one man. Later heirs repeat the pattern and eventually declared themselves to be Niranjanias instead of Guru's Sikhs, turning inherited association into open distance from the Guru's path.
The page therefore moves from personal arrogance to sectarian degeneration. Even external markers remain, but the inner practice of Waheguru-centered devotion is shown as having been hollowed out.
